_comment: Title and description of the champion game pages, the ONE source for both the prerendered HTML (scripts/generate-route-html.cjs) and the rendered page (GameList, BestGames). {name} is the champion's full name. Before 2026-11-11 the two were written separately and differed, so Google saw two titles and two descriptions per page.
